title: Secretary Uniform Three-View Character Sheet

promptText: # Reference Sheet Generation Instructions [Input Items] Sheet Type: [Design-focused / Simple] Default is [Design-focused]. Uniform Color: [Navy / Bordeaux / Gray] Default is [Gray]. Maintain the silhouette, head-to-body ratio, and proportions of the reference image exactly. Do not correct, idealize, or redesign the body in 01 FRONT to make the uniform fit. Maintain eye shape/size, eye position, eyebrows, nose bridge, nose tip, mouth shape, lip thickness, chin shape, contours, cheek impression, and face aspect ratio as much as possible; do not align with a generalized secretary model face. Maintain hairstyle, bangs, parting, length, and volume. Ensure it looks like the actual person from the reference image is wearing the uniform, rather than a different person. Includes a waist seam with a short, modest peplum. The skirt is a knee-length tight silhouette, not excessively short. Shoes are simple plain pumps. No bags, paper cups, handheld items, or large accessories. [Neck Scarf] Most important. Attach a thin white neckband-style decoration to the collar, with the knot fixed on the wearer's left side. The color is fixed to white (a soft, clean white, avoiding yellowing or intense gloss). [Uniform Color] Follow the input for [Uniform Color]. Navy: Calm, deep navy body. Bordeaux: Elegant, deep bordeaux body. Gray: Sophisticated medium-brightness gray body. All cases should be solid colors; avoid excessive patterns, strong gloss, or flashy decorations. Avoid rough sketches, sloppy setting drawings, or low-density reference styles. [Common Pose] Include the full body from head to toe for all three figures. Prohibit crossed arms, crossed legs, extreme model poses, or excessive action. [Sheet Type: Design-focused] Aspect ratio fixed at 1:1 square. Background is a light neutral gray near white. Divide the square into a main area on the left (approx. 60%) and a vertical sub-area on the right (approx. 40%). Place a large 01 FRONT on the left. Divide the right side into two vertical tiers: 02 SIDE on top and 03 BACK on bottom. The two right panels should have equal width/height, organized with thin border lines to appear as a single vertical block. SIDE and BACK should be close in scale with consistent margins. Do not remove the boxed 2-tier structure or place SIDE/BACK freely. [Design-focused Character Orientation] 01 FRONT is a natural upright posture facing forward. Maintain naturalness without being too stiff, but prioritize character identification and uniform shape. 02 SIDE is a "nearly profile" view, rotated very slightly from a full 90-degree side view toward the camera. Only show enough to slightly confirm the front chest, waist, and peplum; avoid a 3/4 view. Fix view numbers and names: "01 FRONT" on the top-left of the main area, "02 SIDE" on the top-left of the top-right panel, "03 BACK" on the top-left of the bottom-right panel. Do not move these to the bottom. Use consistent numbers, letters, horizontal lines, and dots as shared design elements. Place a thin vertical line and small geometric accent in the bottom left. Keep text to SECRETARY/UNIFORM/THREE VIEW; no long descriptions or slogans. [Sheet Type: Simple] Aspect ratio fixed at 1:1 square. Background is a uniform light neutral gray near white. Composition: 3 views arranged horizontally; Left=FRONT, Center=SIDE, Right=BACK. Align head height, foot position, scale, and proportions.
